scope.definition: Every explicit static import declaration in the eleven material files is recorded verbatim and its direct repository target or declared external/runtime provider is identified. This is a direct-import closure and a pinned integration frontier, not a recursively enumerated TypeScript or runtime dependency graph.
scope.evidenceClass: Static repository inspection plus separately identified, previously observed hosted selections.

sourceInputs.description: Parent-produced W/S/material/target identities; each of eleven local material preimages was read and matched against SHA-256, Git blob SHA and byte length.

method.remoteReads: Read-only GitHub MCP pinned file, commit and compare retrievals. No network fetch through shell, Git mutation, local test or compiler.
method.relativeImports: Normalized the literal relative file path against the importing file; exact .ts and .json suffixes retained. Full Git blob metadata was read at W3 and target for all 44 inherited direct targets.
method.workspaceImports: Resolved @orchestra/core subpaths through exact keys in packages/core/package.json exports; no wildcard, extension, condition or package-directory guessing.
method.externalImports: Recorded literal SDK subpaths and Effect package declarations/catalog/patch references. No installed-package resolution or package-manager execution is claimed.
method.typeImports: importKind records a whole declaration beginning with import type as type; exact declaration text remains authoritative for mixed named imports.
method.staticScan: All material imports in this snapshot are explicit single-line import declarations. No dynamic import expression was found in these eleven files.
method.baseInheritance: The complete GitHub base-to-W3 comparison contains twelve paths: ACK68 and eleven material files. All other repository dependencies and configuration are inherited from base7e1.
boundaries: Transitive imports, barrel re-exports, conditional exports inside third-party packages, generated files, platform libraries and final compiler module resolution are not exhaustively resolved by this review.
The compiler must inspect a real nonempty program; the existence of files or matching hashes is not evidence of successful loading, type compatibility, tool execution or native host admission.
Source runtime evidence stays attached to its original W/S and selected tests. Nothing in this document reruns or upgrades a failed selection.
No inert owner proposal, preimage, postimage, patch or proposed URL becomes executable intake through this document.

sourceDelta.assertion: Exactly two production replacements and nine new test/helper files, plus ACK68. No production dependency outside the two owned files was changed by68.
